$comment: Review state for every prototype page. `state` and `outcome` are a human judgement; `closed` MIRRORS the collector's round status in feedback/<id>.json and must not be hand-flipped ahead of it. review-check.mjs fails on any drift, on a missing page, and on a closure the collector has not recorded. See README 'The review system'. Cleared 2026-09-30: every page that is not approved in the review tool was reset to unreviewed. The reasoning and ticket numbers stay in `note`/`tickets`; the mark records were removed because the check derives state from them. Git history holds the originals.

pages.note: Reviewed 2026-10-04 by the owner and deliberately NOT approved: it is a reference to consult, not a candidate. Left unreviewed in the registry because that state means "approved", and it was not. Kept on disk.
Round 1: the synthesis mark should read more like a calendar. Flagged for rebuild rather than a tweak, so the mark is redrawn and shown again at the sizes it ships at.
